lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ is in the derivative form: مَُدَّثِّرٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/ث/ر   d–th–r to become blotted out, to be forgotten; to become cold, to rust; to be covered, to be wrapped up, an outer garment. Of this root, مُدَثِّرٌ muddaththir occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَُدَّثِّرٌ muddaththir [an assimilated form of act. part. مُتَدَثِّر mutadaththir of v. V تَدَّثَّرَ taddaththara]

1 one who is wrapping himself up

(74:1–2) قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ you, the one wrapping yourself [in your cloak], arise and give warning; * الْمُدَّثِّرُ name of Sura 74, Meccan sura, so‐named because of reference in verse

1 to ‘the Wrapped One’.
